Version packages: 0.2.3 (#119)

This PR was opened by the [Changesets
release](https://github.com/changesets/action) GitHub action. When
you're ready to do a release, you can merge this and the packages will
be published to npm automatically. If you're not ready to do a release
yet, that's fine, whenever you add more changesets to main, this PR will
be updated.


# Releases
## openfilm@0.2.3

### Patch Changes

- [#139](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/139)
[`b12dbdc`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/b12dbdce341b62a442e2b38e43b121adf7c26d4a)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Settings › Providers ›
Microsoft Azure sets up each Azure service on its own, since Azure has
no one key for all of them: Azure AI Speech (voice-over) takes its
resource's region and its key in two fields, instead of one
`<region>:<key>` to type.

- [#114](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/114)
[`f90e8ab`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f90e8abb389c096a6a318341c01ea5643596ebf8)
Thanks [@taavie-z](https://github.com/taavie-z)! - Choose cover images
when adding skills, and replace or remove covers for your own skills
from their details.

- [#120](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/120)
[`e199314`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/e1993148e81402f78dcd72687c188b8fee582d18)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Settings › Agents:
Claude Code waiting in the Claude app shows only how to get it (open the
app's Code tab once), without an Install button that led elsewhere.

- [#145](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/145)
[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Page clips have
component properties. Select a layer and click ◇ beside its words, its
picture or its appearance to make it a property; the clip's Properties
section lists only those, each renamed with a double-click, filled in
for this clip, and reset on its own or all at once. Variables of the
page can be added from the section's +. A clip added to Saved keeps its
properties and shows as a component, and every clip taken from it offers
them. The Template section that listed everything a page holds is gone.

- [#140](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/140)
[`b6b632a`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/b6b632a6a74730deeaf28d42b8a3d6c0a030c7ea)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Export › Editing
project › 剪映 or CapCut: when the app's drafts folder refuses the write
(on Windows, security software often does), the draft is made in the
exports folder instead of the export failing with "EPERM: operation not
permitted, mkdir". The export says so, and where to move it.

[`c344c1f`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/c344c1f53f32331784aa8ebbaa437216ee0c233f)

media pane's right-click menu when the library or a folder is empty,
including over the empty-state message. Existing file and folder menus
keep their own actions.

[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)

top bar is a button that says Export. A chosen project's outline shows
whole, never cut by the edge of the list. Settings › Keyboard shortcuts
lists the keys without a panel behind them.

[`4503390`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/4503390dcb31c421948a2a517cb040c9e6cf043d)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Studio: scrolling in
the export dialog no longer makes the window flicker on macOS. Nothing
behind the dialog is blurred, and a scroll that reaches the end of a
list stops there instead of moving the page behind.

- [#145](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/145)
[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)

action in tabs (Timeline, Player, Basic, Other) and lets you switch

custom schemes take any keys you record: changing a key in a built-in
scheme copies it to a custom one first, and a key already in use asks
before it moves. Menus and tooltips show the keys of the scheme in use.

[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)

the same skills agents get. A skill named in a message is for that
message only; its instructions go to the agent once per conversation,
unseen in the chat.

[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)

slower in Studio keeps its pitch, at a clip's speed and at the viewer's
playback speed, as it does in an export. Before, the preview sped sound
up like a tape, so it was heard higher or lower.

[`a7f0a1e`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/a7f0a1ef461f346ae73e53ca9eb7932f80bb2c39)

and "Reveal in Finder" (Explorer on Windows) are in the project tab's

playhead until you turn it on.

- [#145](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/145)
[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Projects and tabs keep
in step. A project deleted (in the Projects window, another tab, by an
agent) or whose folder is gone closes its tabs without asking, all of
them together, and the front goes to a tab that stays; none of them
comes back with Reopen Closed Tab. The Projects window never stays on
"Creating project" or "Opening project", reads the list again whenever
it is shown, and has the tabs in its top bar while any are open. Closing
the last tab starts the next launch on the Projects window. Changes to

- [#135](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/135)
[`8209ca4`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/8209ca45a5a1d1d067a926ba26f3e7b8b9222cb9)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - Pressing Undo again and
again no longer makes the editor disappear. An edit that cannot be
undone, because the agent changed or removed what it was about since,
says why once and leaves the history, so the next Undo goes on to the
edit before it and Undo stops at the oldest one.

- [#145](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/pull/145)
[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)
Thanks [@PazChen](https://github.com/PazChen)! - The viewer's loop
button is now a playback settings menu: loop, subtitles on the picture,
and playback speed from 0.25× to 2×. The aspect ratio button under the
picture is gone; the inspector's Stage menu has every shape, with
Original at the top.

[`b12dbdc`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/b12dbdce341b62a442e2b38e43b121adf7c26d4a)

Microsoft Azure sets up each Azure service on its own, since Azure has
no one key for all of them: Azure AI Speech (voice-over) takes its
resource's region and its key in two fields, instead of one
`<region>:<key>` to type.

[`f90e8ab`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f90e8abb389c096a6a318341c01ea5643596ebf8)
Thanks [@taavie-z](https://github.com/taavie-z)! - Choose cover images
when adding skills, and replace or remove covers for your own skills
from their details.

[`e199314`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/e1993148e81402f78dcd72687c188b8fee582d18)

Claude Code waiting in the Claude app shows only how to get it (open the
app's Code tab once), without an Install button that led elsewhere.

[`f6b1df1`](https://github.com/openfilm/openfilm/commit/f6b1df146ee5582ad3dc884f6c2eb821b7a05f40)

section lists only those, each renamed with a double-click, filled in
for this clip, and reset on its own or all at once. Variables of the
page can be added from the section's +. A clip added to Saved keeps its
properties and shows as a component, and every clip taken from it offers
them. The Template section that listed everything a page holds is gone.

project › 剪映 or CapCut: when the app's drafts folder refuses the write
(on Windows, security software often does), the draft is made in the
exports folder instead of the export failing with "EPERM: operation not
permitted, mkdir". The export says so, and where to move it.

keep their own actions.

Studio: another speed is heard at once, its pitch kept by the browser (#146)

## What and why

In 0.2.3 the preview kept a sound's pitch at another speed by asking the
server for a copy re-encoded with atempo, one per file and speed. On a
long video every speed change meant several seconds of silence while the
whole sound was encoded, fetched and decoded, and atempo made voices
sound hollow.

Now a sound heard at another speed (its clip's speed by the viewer's) is
played by the browser's own media element with `preservesPitch`, routed
into the same mix (meters, volume, fades and solo as before). A speed
change is heard at once. Each check (250 ms) puts an element back in
place when it drifts more than 0.12 s from the film, then lets it settle
for a second. A sound at 1× is still decoded and played sample-accurate.
The server's `&speed=` copies are gone.

The viewer's playback button showed the same icon as the inspector's
toggle (Settings2); it is a speed gauge now.

## Tested

- A 20-minute video cut into two clips, in Studio: switching to 0.75×,
2× and 0.25× while playing was heard 40–45 ms after the click,
`preservesPitch` on; the element's place matched the timecode to within
a frame over several seconds; crossing into the second clip (file second
400) landed on the right second; back to 1× the decoded sound took over
and no element kept playing.
- The desktop app from source (by the owner): the long video that was
silent and hollow in 0.2.3 plays at once and sounds natural.
- `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm audit:public`, `pnpm check:pack`.

commit.message:
Own agent: pictures within a request's size, and a 413 tried again with half of them (#148)

## What and why

A person reported that a conversation with the app's own agent (their
own key) stopped for good after twelve minutes: every message,
"continue" included, came back HTTP 413 from the model service's proxy.
The request had grown to 62 MB, 61.5 MB of it 37 frames from `openfilm
look`, each sent again with every request. Nothing kept it in bounds: Pi
counts a picture as a small, fixed number of tokens, so its compaction
never saw it, and Pi neither retries a 413 nor, but for Anthropic's own
wording, compacts for one.

- **Pictures keep their quality.** Pi's own limits stay (2000 px, 4.5 MB
per picture): a 1080p frame goes as it is.
- **A request stays within its size.** It carries the pictures of the
agent's latest five reads, and at most 32 MB of them, the request size
Anthropic's API documents. An older picture is left out of the request
(a `context` hook; never out of the session) with a line naming its
file, so the agent can read it again.
- **A 413 is tried again with half the pictures.** Pi's own retry (once,
the failed attempt left out of what is sent) now takes a request refused
as too large, a proxy's HTML page included, when it held pictures; the
request goes with half of them, and the chat says so. A request too
large with no pictures is not tried again, and says so plainly.
- **Settings › Agents** says the own agent's rules are the project's own
AGENTS.md (other places are not read), in five languages.

## Tested

- A fake service refusing bodies over 8 MB with an openresty 413 page:
14 pictures (13 MB) are refused once, then sent again with 7 of them
left out, and the turn goes on. Over 4 MB: the retry fails too, the
error says so, and the next message goes through with fewer. No
pictures: not tried again.
- `fitImages`: the latest five reads keep their pictures, an older one
is a line naming its file, the person's attachments stay, the session is
untouched.
- The desktop app from source with the owner's own key.
- `pnpm test`, `pnpm typecheck`, `pnpm audit:public`, `pnpm check:pack`.
